CanonicalBoundary.description: Actor-consistent position in the canonical event stream.

event_hash.description: Hash of the preceding event, or the event header at sequence zero.

next_event_seq.description: Sequence number that will be assigned to the next event.

output_bytes.description: PTY output bytes included through this boundary.

description: An exact presentation-eligible endpoint within a validated canonical prefix.

boundary.description: Exact source prefix that was validated during resolution.

cols.description: Canonical viewport columns at the endpoint.

event_byte_offset.description: Inclusive output byte offset when the endpoint is an output event.

event_seq.description: Final emitted event; absent for the initial blank state.

rows.description: Canonical viewport rows at the endpoint.

session_manifest_hash.description: Commitment to the source session manifest.

source_complete.description: Whether the selected source has validated durable completion.

state_hash.description: Hash of the complete normalized semantic state at the endpoint.

state_id.description: Stream position of the endpoint state.
